audit.whatIsWrong: The page is built on a false premise: it says Spirit's Refuge 'blocks my autos plus Q hits', 'neuters my Q-Blooming Burst poke' and 'blocks my burst' in five separate places.
audit.why: Riot's text for Shen's W is 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked' — it blocks basic attacks only. Blooming Burst is a spell and passes straight through the zone. This is the decisive interaction of the matchup and the page had it backwards.
audit.corrected: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, not spells — Q still lands through it; the zone only costs you autos and the Shapesplitter third-attack proc.

audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating 4/10, carryRating 5/10 and 'Favoured matchup' on a 44% lane whose chart gives Shen four of seven rows. phases[5].side said Shen while whys[5] said the window is 'roughly even'.
audit.why: 44% over 25 games with a Shen-majority chart is not a favoured lane; the packet chart has row 5 as Skill, matching its own why.
audit.corrected: Difficulty 6.5/10, carry threat 6/10, 'Hard matchup'; row 5 set to Skill in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 spike credited W-clone invisibility for setting up the ult.
audit.why: Neeko's W sends a directional clone; no invisibility appears in the kit. What actually hides the ult is Inherent Glamour: the preparation is hidden while disguised, and the disguise breaks on any immobilizing CC — which is exactly what Shadow Dash applies.
audit.corrected: Level 6 spike now names the disguise and the CC break that ends it.

audit.why: Shadow Dash at 18/16/14/12/10s and 600 range is the punishable cooldown, and the page already tracks it.

edits.before: Shen is the worst kind of early matchup for me: his W (Spirit's Refuge) zone eats every auto and a big chunk of my Q-Blooming Burst, so my poke just evaporates when he walks up. I have no combo at level 1 and only single-target Q value, so I concede the opener and last-hit at max Q range. My only real early move is at 3 — land E-Tangle-Barbs at distance into a Q while his W is down, then back off before his taunt-E closes the gap.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, not spells — Blooming Burst (Q) still lands through it, so poke with the spell and never with autos while the blade zone is up. You have no combo at level 1 and single-target Q value only, so concede the opener and last-hit from 800 range. From 3, land Tangle-Barbs (E) at its full 1000 range into a Q re-bloom, then step back: Shadow Dash is 600 range and 18s at rank 1.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 I farm with Q waveclear and chip when I can, but I won't all-in an immobile tank who out-sustains my single rotation without ult. At 6 I get my one window — if I set up Pop Blossom under W-clone invisibility or a disguise and catch him with W on cooldown, the E-into-Q-into-R combo can force his Flash or a summoner. But respect his E taunt-dash: it cancels my Pop Blossom channel cold, so I must root or bait the dash first.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you farm with Q waveclear and chip where you can, but do not all-in a tank who out-sustains one rotation before you have ult. At 6 you get your window: set up Pop Blossom while disguised — the preparation stays hidden — and E into Q into R can force his Flash. Respect Shadow Dash: it is a 600-range taunting dash, and any immobilize on you breaks the disguise and the setup with it, so root or bait it first.
